name: DOOM 3: BFG Edition
description: DOOM 3: BFG Edition is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person shooter and survival horror game, a remaster of 2004's DOOM 3.

eax.problem: This is the 2012 BFG Edition, not the classic DOOM 3, and it has no EAX.

notes: If you also own the classic DOOM 3, that one has EAX — it comes with the same purchase.
